typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{"project"} as string,
		{"workbook"} as string,
		{"view"} as string,
		{"action"} as string,
		{"user"} as string,
		{"user_name"} as string,
		{"user_email"} as string,
		{"lastview"} as date,
		{"lastlogin"} as date,
		{"viewcount"} as decimal(18,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		workbook as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		view as string,
		user_email as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		user_name as string,
		lastlogin as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		project as string,
		action as string,
		lastview as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		viewcount as integer,
		user as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		workbook = {"workbook"},
		UploadDate,
		view = {"view"},
		user_email = {"user_email"},
		ETLUser,
		user_name = {"user_name"},
		lastlogin = {"lastlogin"},
		project = {"project"},
		action = {"action"},
		lastview = {"lastview"},
		viewcount = {"viewcount"},
		user = {"user"}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
